direct_flat_match_result.interpretation: No direct flat mapping demonstrated. This does not disprove a physical mapping because sample identity/side are unknown and controller-visible objects may be transformed/protected.

mirrored_literal_candidates.qualification: candidate only; same raw byte can have unrelated semantics

hypotheses.statement: The saved chip1 data is a real structured image with internal mirroring/redundancy.
hypotheses.basis: Three identical reads per spare, 96.0938% cross-spare identity, identical 226-byte prefix, exact duplicated 82-byte logical record.

hypotheses.statement: The two physical EEPROMs may serve separate GWG/regulation and GFA/fire-control coding domains or consumers.
hypotheses.basis: Two separate EEPROM faces plus repository-defined separate GFA/GWG revisions and separate GWG versus GFA coding-plug namespaces.

hypotheses.statement: Differences at 0x0E2..0x0F0 are per-device/service/manufacturing/state metadata rather than the shared main parameter image.
hypotheses.basis: Both spares are identical through 0x0E1 and differ only in the later tail/upper block.

hypotheses.statement: The 0x100 upper-block differences may be intentional data or an addressing/read-path peculiarity.
hypotheses.basis: Differences begin exactly at the 24C04 256-byte boundary and bench connection issues were observed later.

hypotheses.statement: The regulation-side 0x7656 summary and GFA coding-plug diagnostics share identity/revision byte values.
hypotheses.basis: Live 0x7656 is 20 15 02 01; GFA P101=15, P102=01 and P107=02 in the same operating configuration. Exact 0x7656 byte-field positions remain unresolved.

hypotheses.statement: Parts of the GFA coding-plug view may be derived from fields inside the mirrored 82-byte record rather than stored as one contiguous P90-P108 block.
hypotheses.basis: Live values 63, 01, 0C and 02 occur at identical corresponding offsets in both logical mirror copies and both spare chip1 images, while identity/date/CRC bytes 15, 14 and D6 are absent. This pattern is compatible with shared parameters plus plug-specific/transformed metadata but is not a field mapping proof.
